title: Anchorage numbered accordion
description: A centred heading over a few wide rows split by hairlines: a big thin number in a lilac hairline ring, a title, a one-line summary and a small circled plus. A row opens smoothly (0.4s ease-in-out) to a list of offerings in the right-hand column, each with an outlined icon tile, a title and a line of detail; the plus turns into a minus. Phones stack title and summary beside the ring and put the list underneath.
notes: rows open independently; defaultOpen lists the ones open at first (static HTML shows those open)
name: anchorage-accordion
